stories.title: Make My Trip launches campaign with Alia Bhatt and Ranveer Singh
stories.summary: Make My Trip has launched the 'Ab Toh Jaana Padega' campaign featuring actors Alia Bhatt and Ranveer Singh. The initiative includes six films promoting travel booking options for year-end planning. The company says the campaign is designed to inspire Indian travelers to plan their next holidays.

stories.title: Gap unveils anamorphic digital out-of-home campaign
stories.summary: Gap has launched its first anamorphic digital out-of-home campaign at retail hubs including Phoenix Palladium and DLF Mall of India. The project features three-dimensional visual storytelling across large-format screens. The brand says the campaign seamlessly merges creativity and technology to provide an interactive experience for shoppers.

stories.title: Sony India and Zepto partner for Singles Day campaign
stories.summary: Sony India and Zepto have launched a campaign for Singles Day featuring the headline P.S. I love you. The promotion highlights the ability to have a PlayStation 5 console delivered in minutes. The creative encourages single consumers to choose gaming over traditional Valentine celebrations.

stories.title: GetLook launches campaign featuring Gulshan Grover
stories.summary: Beauty brand GetLook has released a digital video campaign featuring actor Gulshan Grover to promote its Korean 24K Gold Facial. Titled Gold Kahan Hai, the film uses Grover's screen persona to build curiosity. The company says the campaign positions the service as a premium beauty offering.

stories.title: SBI highlights essential workers in Diwali campaign
stories.summary: State Bank of India has released a festive film titled Ghar Se Dur, Ghar Wali Diwali. The campaign focuses on individuals who remain at work during the holiday season instead of returning home. The bank says the film explores the lives of those who prioritize responsibilities over personal celebrations.

stories.title: Organic Tattva highlights food quality in new campaign
stories.summary: Organic Tattva has launched a digital film featuring brand ambassador Kareena Kapoor Khan. The campaign focuses on the comfort of home-cooked meals to highlight the brand's organic sourcing and transparency. The company says it tests products for more than 250 pesticides and offers test reports via QR codes.

stories.title: Kareena Kapoor Khan stars in Organic Tattva campaign
stories.summary: Organic Tattva has released a digital film titled Home Coming featuring Kareena Kapoor Khan. The campaign emphasizes the brand's use of certified organic farms and testing standards. The company says it provides customers with access to product test reports through QR codes printed on its packaging.

stories.title: PNG Jewellers launches Unstoppable Legacy campaign
stories.summary: PNG Jewellers has unveiled its Unstoppable Legacy campaign featuring actors Madhuri Dixit and Ranbir Kapoor. The campaign highlights the brand's history and collection. The full details of the marketing initiative are available for subscribers.

stories.title: SBI campaign focuses on workers spending Diwali away from home
stories.summary: State Bank of India has introduced a campaign titled Ghar Se Dur, Ghar Wali Diwali. The film acknowledges essential workers who are unable to return home for the festival due to work commitments. The bank says the campaign emphasizes human connection and the spirit of togetherness.

stories.title: Campa Cola spotlights festive preparations
stories.summary: Campa Cola has launched a festive campaign titled Tayyari Big, Tyohaar Bada Big. The initiative showcases community involvement in cleaning and cooking activities during Indian festivals. The brand positions itself as a refreshment for consumers during the hustle of holiday preparations.

stories.title: EU proposes influencer ad disclosure rules
stories.summary: The European Commission has published a Digital Fairness Act proposal that could hold brands liable for influencer ad disclosures even without formal contracts. Commissioner Michael McGrath described the package as the most significant reform of consumer protection rules in 20 years. The proposal must still be approved.

stories.title: Maybelline updates tagline
stories.summary: Maybelline has updated its long-standing tagline to reflect evolving perceptions of beauty. The brand is using ads featuring Miley Cyrus to promote the new phrasing. The full details regarding the specific changes to the brand's messaging are available for subscribers.

stories.title: Lufthansa Group appoints Omnicom Media as global agency
stories.summary: Lufthansa Group has selected Omnicom Media as its global media agency of record for a five-year mandate starting January 1, 2027. The partnership covers brand and performance marketing for its airline brands. Omnicom will manage approximately 10,000 active campaigns across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific.

stories.title: Omnicom Media wins Lufthansa Group global mandate
stories.summary: Omnicom Media has been appointed as the global media agency of record for Lufthansa Group under a five-year contract. The mandate includes brand and performance marketing for airlines such as SWISS and Austrian Airlines. The agency will oversee approximately 10,000 active campaigns worldwide beginning in 2027.

stories.title: Omnicom Media secures Lufthansa Group global mandate
stories.summary: Omnicom Media has won a five-year global media mandate from Lufthansa Group. The agreement brings brand and performance media operations for the airline's major brands under one agency. Omnicom is expected to manage approximately 10,000 active performance campaigns globally starting in January 2027.

stories.title: Brands bypass traditional agency pitches
stories.summary: A growing number of advertisers are directly appointing agencies without holding multi-agency pitches. WPP CEO Cindy Rose has criticized the practice as a CEO handshake thing, while Publicis Groupe has defended the trend. The shift has led to a public dispute between the two major holding companies.

stories.title: Advertisers shift mobile budgets to independent partners
stories.summary: A survey of 166 brands and agencies indicates that nearly 64% of advertisers have moved mobile budgets from walled gardens to independent partners over the past year. While Meta and Google continue to attract the majority of digital ad spend, some publishers are beginning to regain budget share.

stories.title: Meta gains as Google faces AI ad challenges
stories.summary: Google's stock price dropped after a slowdown in search advertising growth, which some analysts attribute to the company's AI Mode. Meanwhile, agency executives report moving ad dollars to Meta. Meta has been introducing new AI products that do not compete with its core advertising business.

stories.title: Indian brands test ChatGPT ads with mixed results
stories.summary: Indian brands are spending up to 10 lakh rupees a month testing ChatGPT ads, according to 0101.today. Early feedback indicates inconsistent conversions and high acquisition costs, leaving advertisers with little evidence to justify larger budgets. Most brands are still treating the platform as a trial.

stories.summary: Special Coverage “Range matters now”: Microsoft’s Puneet Chandok, GrowthSchool’s Vaibhav Sisinty on the skills that will define Gen Z careers Indian advertisers are yet to see consistent conversion results from ChatGPT advertising, with relatively high customer acquisition costs and limited campaign data making brands cautious

stories.title: ChatGPT ads show low conversion rates in India
stories.summary: Early ChatGPT advertising campaigns in India show conversion rates below 1.5 percent, compared to 3 percent on Google and Meta. While costs per thousand impressions have dropped significantly, the lower pricing has yet to establish a clear case for sustained investment as brands struggle with performance.

stories.title: Bata India increases marketing spend
stories.summary: Bata India increased its marketing investment by over 4 percent in the first half of fiscal year 2027. The footwear maker is prioritising community building and product relevance for younger consumers, aiming to sharpen the efficiency of its advertising investments rather than simply increasing the total budget.

stories.title: Lenovo appoints Shilpa Marodia as Marketing Director for India and South Asia
stories.summary: Lenovo announced the appointment of Shilpa Marodia as the Marketing Director for India and South Asia, as it continues to strengthen its presence in one of its most important growth markets. Based in Bengaluru, Marodia will lead the brand and marketing strategy for Lenovo’s full-stack

stories.title: Savlon ad campaign highlights antibiotic misuse
stories.summary: ITC-owned Savlon has released an ad film featuring a song that celebrates taking antibiotics for minor ailments without medical advice. The lyrics reword familiar drug names into rhymes, highlighting the habit of treating medicine as casually as sweets. The brand is warning against the very behaviour it depicts.

stories.title: Wedding influencer rates rise by 25 percent
stories.summary: India’s wedding season is driving a 20 to 25 percent surge in influencer rates as brands increase campaign budgets. Agencies report a 30 to 35 percent rise in enquiries for creators across beauty, travel, and occasion wear. The wedding shopping journey is now a primary marketing focus.

stories.title: AI clauses reshape Indian influencer contracts
stories.summary: Brands and agencies in India are beginning to negotiate AI rights in influencer contracts, including permissions to clone a creator’s face or voice. These talks are creating new commercial terms regarding who retains control over digital replicas and what the AI versions are permitted to endorse.

stories.title: Content budgets shift toward creators and sports
stories.summary: Consultancy KPMG reports that entertainment content spending reached 207 billion dollars in 2025, up from 156 billion in 2021. The data indicates that traditional film and television are losing ground as major platforms shift their budgets toward sports and independent creators to capture audience attention.

stories.title: Entertainment 360 acquires influencer firm Brigade
stories.summary: Entertainment 360 has acquired Brigade, a management firm representing digital talent including podcasters and Substack writers. Brigade founder Max Stein will join the company as a partner. The move marks an expansion beyond traditional film and television representation into the influencer and creator economy.

stories.title: Political ads drive viewers away from streaming
stories.summary: Nearly 10% of streamers upgraded to ad-free subscriptions, canceled services, or stopped watching during the 2024 midterms, according to data linked to record political spending. While adults aged 35 to 44 proved the most ad-averse, 28% of viewers aged 18 to 24 reported feeling better informed by the campaigns.

stories.title: Lyft tests home screen ad takeovers
stories.summary: Lyft is testing a home masthead ad unit that grants brands full ownership of the app home screen before a ride is booked. The company, which saw its ad business grow 100% year over year in 2025, is currently running alpha tests with partners including Pluto TV and Google.

stories.title: Twitch introduces shoppable and skippable ads
stories.summary: Twitch has debuted a pair of new ad products intended to meet full-funnel marketing needs. The launch coincides with the platform's annual TwitchCon gathering, as the livestreaming service works to expand its advertising capabilities for brands and creators.

stories.title: IAS expands TikTok ad measurement tools
stories.summary: Integral Ad Science has extended its Total Media Quality measurement suite to include CapCut, Lemon8, and additional TikTok ad formats. The update covers placements like TopView and TikTok Shop, building on a partnership established in 2020 to monitor a platform with more than 1 billion users.

stories.title: IAB calls for standardized view counts
stories.summary: The IAB is requesting that platforms standardize how they define a view. Following YouTube's August update to its counting method, internal data and creator experiments suggested public view counts were inflated by 40%. YouTube previously stated the change was intended to help creators express their true value.

stories.title: Yahoo licenses AI content via collective model
stories.summary: Yahoo has become the first licensee of the Internet Licensing Collective, a model designed to pay publishers based on how their content is used in AI-powered search. The deal allows publishers to license their work for use in Yahoo's Scout search engine rather than relying on one-off agreements.

stories.title: Zefr adds ad quality tracking for TikTok and CapCut
stories.summary: Zefr has extended its ad measurement services to CapCut and TikTok's opening-screen TopView ads. The company now provides four separate quality measurements for these surfaces, alongside expanded coverage for carousel ads and search inventory. The announcement arrived simultaneously with a similar update from a competitor.

stories.title: X launches video clipping tool
stories.summary: X has released a video-trimming feature that allows users to splice longer videos into shorter clips for posting. The company says every clip includes a label linking back to the original video. The tool is the latest effort by the platform to attract influencers and drive engagement.

stories.title: Mars prepares for AI-driven grocery shopping
stories.summary: Mars is researching how to maintain impulse snack sales as AI agents take over more weekly grocery runs. While the company does not expect AI to eliminate in-store checkout lanes, it is hedging against an agentic future where shopping assistants handle more of the consumer's purchasing decisions.

stories.summary: YouTube and Creators HQ have launched an incubator to train 1,000 creators across the Middle East and North Africa. The program aims to help participants earn commissions through YouTube Shopping, providing them with industry expertise and access to global platforms over the next two years.

stories.title: Meta reports revenue growth alongside heavy AI spending
stories.summary: Meta reported third-quarter revenue growth exceeding expectations, citing AI-powered recommendations for increased engagement. The company noted rapid adoption of its Muse AI agent, though heavy infrastructure spending pushed quarterly free cash flow into negative territory. AI is currently expensive to build.

stories.title: BlueMedia partners with ChatGPT Ads
stories.summary: BlueMedia has launched a partnership with ChatGPT Ads to help Chinese brands navigate AI-powered conversational search. The collaboration aims to explore AI-native advertising as the platform, which reports 1.2 billion weekly active users, continues its global expansion into decision-making and product comparison scenarios.

stories.title: The gap between data and decisions
stories.summary: Enterprises possess ample data on site visits and cart abandonment but struggle to translate these metrics into actionable business decisions. Despite a decade of investment in marketing clouds and analytics platforms, companies still rely on late reports and manual team analysis to determine their next steps.

stories.title: IAB releases AI conversion framework
stories.summary: The IAB has unveiled a new framework for measuring the impact of AI on conversions. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: And And Brand Partners expands agency model
stories.summary: And And Brand Partners has launched a new agency model combining creative, digital, media, and business consulting services. The expanded ecosystem aims to help brands navigate a complex landscape where communication and consumer engagement are increasingly interconnected. The agency has added many things to its list.

stories.title: Marketing automation is dead and alive
stories.summary: Marketing automation is dead. Long live marketing automation. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Zingtree debuts agentic governance platform
stories.summary: Zingtree has launched a governance platform for AI agents in regulated industries like healthcare and finance. Adoption of AI agents in customer service grew 70 percent from 2025 to 2026, though governance has struggled to keep pace. The platform aims to manage costs while maintaining oversight.

stories.title: Fullstory releases StoryAI agents
stories.summary: Fullstory has made its StoryAI agents and Model Context Protocol generally available to customers. The company says its AI does not just report events but watches, investigates, and delivers answers to the right person or agent. Teams are now using the tools to review sessions at scale.

research.title: Designing Institutions for Autonomous AI
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: As autonomous AI agents increasingly interact in persistent populations, their collective capabilities and alignment depend not only on individual models, but also on the institutions governing their interactions. Yet AI research has largely focused on individual. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Efficient Influence Minimization via Source-Integrated Sampling
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Influence minimization by node blocking is a fundamental problem in graph data management that seeks a small set of vertices whose removal minimizes the expected spread from a fixed source set. It supports decisions about where. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: HyBridge: Bridge-Guided Self-Supervised Hyperbolic Hypergraph Representation Learning
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Hypergraphs capture groupwise relationships among multiple nodes and often exhibit tree-like structures. Although hyperbolic space is well suited for modeling such structures, simply extending existing hypergraph representation learning (HRL) methods to hyperbolic space does not consistently. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Insights from GitHub Community on the Matter Standard: Developer Perspectives and Challenges
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Matter seeks to resolve longstanding interoperability problems in the Internet of Things (IoT), yet little is known about how developers experience the standard in day to day work. This paper examines over 13,000 issues from the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: R Package iglm: Regression under Interference in Connected Populations
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce R package iglm, which implements a unifying regression framework for studying relationships among binary, count-, and real-valued predictors and outcomes in connected populations with interference due to spillover, contagion, and other complex phenomena. On. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Regime-Uncertain Data Transactions: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Self-Adapting and Self-Diagnosing Multi-ML-Agent Systems
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autonomous ML agents in large organizations exchange data and model outputs across organizational and legal boundaries. Which rules bind a given exchange is not fixed. It depends on where the data subjects live, where the agents. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Sima AIunty: Caste Audit in LLM-Driven Matchmaking
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Social and personal decisions in relational domains such as matchmaking are deeply entwined with cultural norms and historical hierarchies, and can potentially be shaped by algorithmic and AI-mediated assessments of compatibility, acceptance, and stability. In South. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Steering Emergent Behavior in Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Information Networks
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in groups, each pursuing an individual objective while jointly determining system performance. If an operator controls which agent observes which other agent, but not their payoffs or messages, how. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
